description: Containerised Python web app on AWS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer (plain HTTP). Use for long-running servers, websockets-free web apps with pip dependencies. The app is app/main.py; it MUST listen on 0.0.0.0 at the port in env PORT (default 8080) and answer GET / with a non-5xx status. Optional app/requirements.txt (installed at start). Costs more than Lambda while running, so prefer Lambda unless the user needs a regular always-on server.
